front: Plants burst from the ground in a burst, damaging creatures; the plant type you pick sets damage type and crit-failure effect.
back:
2d4 damage, basic Reflex save; type depends on plant chosen when Casting.
Cacti: piercing; crit failure 1 persistent bleed.
Flowers: poison; crit failure dazzled 2 rounds.
Fruits: bludgeoning; crit failure clumsy 1 for 2 rounds.
Roots: bludgeoning; crit failure prone.
Heightened (+1): +1d4 damage; cacti bleed +1.
